YoshTool — dark-mode test fixture

Serve over http. Run Dev → Toggle dark mode (or right-click → “Toggle dark mode”).

1 · Light page → should go dark

This paragraph is dark text on a white page. After toggling dark mode, the background should become dark and the text light — and toggling again restores it.

2 · A “photo” (gradient) → should KEEP its colors

Dark mode inverts the page, then re-inverts images/video/canvas, so this colorful block should look about the same (not turn into a negative).

3 · Colored UI swatches → these invert with the page

(plain background-color boxes — fine to invert)

4 · Test the “already dark” skip

Turn this ON, then run YoshTool dark mode — it should detect the page is already dark and show “Page already looks dark — left unchanged” instead of double-darkening.
